lead: A `for update skip locked` range scan on MySQL or MariaDB waits instead of skipping under `repeatable read`.
body: InnoDB's locking read also locks the index record just past the range, and `skip locked` does not step over that record; a scan that ends at the supremum never shows it, so a test passes until the index range ends at a real row. Open a claim's transaction at `read committed` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/worker.rs`'s `framed_claim`), and run `bun nv db-matrix --no-up --driver mysql --driver mariadb` after any change to a locked read's shape.
